Theorem
[parallel invariance of the curvature-operator image] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 2.2.2\group Cao–Zhu Strong Maximum Principle Suppose the curvature operator $M_{\alpha \beta }$ of the initial metric is nonnegative. Then, under the Ricci flow, for some interval $0<t<\delta $ the image of $M_{\alpha \beta }$ is a Lie subalgebra of $so(n)$ which has constant rank and is invariant under parallel translation and invariant in time.
